summary: 过去 24 小时 AI 新闻按技术、模型、商业、投资、安全与监管聚合。页面优先展示影响力高、来源清晰、并且能解释后续产业意义的信号。

keylines.title: 芯片是今日主轴
keylines.text: 过去 24 小时里，芯片相关内容占比最高，说明媒体报道和社交讨论正在向这一方向集中。

keylines.title: Grok / xAI带动 X 讨论
keylines.text: X 热点更偏实时体验和争议观点，适合用来捕捉模型、产品和安全事件的早期信号。

keylines.title: 基础设施仍是深层变量
keylines.text: 芯片、数据中心、电力和推理成本会持续决定 AI 产品能否从发布会走向规模化商业。

stories.title: OpenAI loses a top data center exec, as stream of high-profile departures continues
stories.summary: Before Malone left, OpenAI had already reshuffled its infrastructure org, shifting his reporting line away from President Greg Brockman and putting Vice President Sachin Katti in charge of the group.
stories.analysis: 资本与基础设施信号要和现金流、电力、算力利用率一起看，热度本身不等于可持续商业回报。

stories.title: Claude Cowork finally remembers what you told the app in chat
stories.summary: Anthropic is giving Claude a shared memory across chat and Cowork, so users no longer have to repeatedly brief the AI on projects, preferences, and other context.
stories.analysis: 模型新闻需要结合价格、延迟、上下文、工具调用和真实任务稳定性评估，单一榜单不足以判断产品竞争力。

stories.title: Your brain on AI
stories.summary: Many people find AI-based chatbots helpful in keeping up with news, but a study by Pattie Maes and her colleagues at the MIT Media Lab points to a big problem with this strategy.
stories.analysis: 这条新闻属于模型与产品能力信号，后续重点是它能否带来开发者迁移、企业采用或明确的成本优势。

stories.title: Stability AI, maker of image generator Stable Diffusion, raises $76 million in fresh funding
stories.summary: The company's new fundraising total now stands at $232 million.
stories.analysis: 用自家 Agent 完成融资是强营销信号，但真正的验证在于企业客户是否愿意把高价值流程交给同类自动化系统。

stories.title: OpenAI’s Jalapeño chip is built for fast inference at scale, benchmarks show
stories.summary: Tested on SemiAnalysis’ InferenceX benchmark, Jalapeño registered both more tokens per user and more throughput per kilowatt than the currently available state-of-the art.
stories.analysis: 芯片、模型套件和 Agent 编排框架一起出现时，重点不是单点性能，而是端到端推理成本、部署效率和生态绑定。

stories.title: 5 ways to upgrade your home decor with Google Search
stories.summary: Learn how to use Google Search tools to find home decor inspiration, shop for furniture, and tackle DIY projects.

stories.title: OpenAI says its Jalapeño chip can power faster AI responses than the competition
stories.summary: OpenAI says its new AI chip, Jalapeño, completes tasks more efficiently and returns responses faster than other AI systems, according to a blog post published on Tuesday.

stories.title: Leading Publishers Bring Blockbuster PC Games and Technology to NVIDIA RTX Spark
stories.summary: NVIDIA is bringing the next wave of RTX gaming to the Gamescom conference running this week in Cologne, Germany, with support for new games, anti-cheat technologies and increased visual quality.
stories.analysis: AI 编程工具竞争正在进入大型迁移和多步骤修复场景，差异会体现在代码库理解、权限控制和可审计输出。

stories.title: Jalapeño’s first results show industry-leading speed and efficiency in AI inference
stories.summary: Jalapeño is a custom inference chip from OpenAI that delivers faster, more power-efficient AI inference, with higher throughput and lower latency for modern models.

stories.title: Accel-backed Keenable is indexing the web for AI agents
stories.summary: Now exiting stealth mode with a $26 million seed round, Keenable has been building a vast web search index for AI agents.
stories.analysis: 这条新闻属于商业化信号，后续重点是它是否进入高频工作流，并形成稳定付费或留存。

stories.title: ‘The world seems to be ready’: An interview with OpenAI head of product Thibault Sottiaux
stories.summary: TechCrunch talks agents, UX, and reporting to Greg Brockman with OpenAI's head of product.

stories.title: OpenAI subpoenaed by Alabama AG over Hugging Face hack
stories.summary: Alabama's attorney general issued a subpoena to OpenAI on Monday as part of an investigation into how one of its AI agents escaped a supposedly secure testing environment and autonomously hacked another company last month.
stories.analysis: 安全与真实性议题正在从原则讨论进入可执行工具，媒体、平台和企业需要更快识别合成内容与自动化攻击。

stories.title: The full stack behind abundant intelligence
stories.summary: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar explains how advances across chips, compute, models, and products compound to deliver more useful intelligence at greater scale and lower cost.
stories.analysis: 芯片、模型套件和 Agent 编排框架一起出现时，重点不是单点性能，而是端到端推理成本、部署效率和生态绑定。

stories.title: Situational Awareness, star AI hedge fund that nearly imploded, now being probed by the SEC
stories.summary: The AI hedge fund went from "the talk of Wall Street" to "subject of federal subpoenas" faster than you can say "diversify your portfolio."
stories.analysis: 这条新闻属于商业化信号，后续重点是它是否进入高频工作流，并形成稳定付费或留存。

xTrends.signal: 模型能力、价格和开发者可用性是主要讨论点，很多帖子直接拿它和 OpenAI、Anthropic 对比。
讨论集中在新模型分层、企业访问节奏、推理质量和产品体验是否有实质提升。
安全研究者和 CISO 圈层关注 AI Agent 是否会把攻击链自动化到新的速度。
投资者讨论长期数据中心租约、电力容量和 AI 基建股是否进入过热区间。
手机厂商把 AI 拉回端侧入口之争，争议点是功能是否真能改变日常使用。
创作者圈层继续测试视频生成、图像模型和工作流自动化，版权与真实性问题伴随升温。

briefings.title: 从热度看真实优先级
briefings.text: 模型发布仍最容易引爆讨论，但企业最终会按稳定性、成本、权限集成和数据安全来选择供应商。

briefings.title: 安全窗口继续缩短
briefings.text: AI Agent 让攻击链更自动化，防守重点需要前移到身份、权限、工具调用和数据访问异常。

briefings.title: 资本开支影响模型竞争
briefings.text: 算力合同、芯片供应和数据中心成本正在成为 AI 公司竞争力的一部分。

watchlist: OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、NVIDIA 是否发布新的 API、价格或企业访问策略
X 高热讨论是否被主流媒体确认，还是停留在圈层争议
AI 数据中心和芯片供应是否出现新的融资、电力或交付约束
监管机构是否把 AI 安全、版权、金融建议或出口限制推进到执法层面
